question: How do you monitor CPU and memory usage on Linux?
answer:
- `top` / `htop`: real-time per-process CPU and memory usage
- `vmstat`: system-level memory, swap, CPU stats
- `free -h`: memory and swap summary
- `mpstat -P ALL 1`: per-CPU utilization
- `sar`: historical system stats (requires `sysstat`)
- `cat /proc/meminfo`: detailed memory breakdown
- `ps aux --sort=-%cpu`: sorted process list
